name: RIOT Bitcoin Infrastructure & Power Valuation
rationale: Riot Platforms (RIOT) operates ~24 EH/s of Bitcoin mining capacity and 1+ GW of power infrastructure across Corsicana and Rockdale, Texas. GAAP DCF yields $11.23 (-37.7% vs $18.03 current), representing the standard GAAP operational cash floor. The market prices RIOT on a leveraged BTC NAV basis (21 analysts consensus $32.40). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in a 49.8% CAGR. Recommendation: MAINTAIN (Core Holding: 36.0 shares, 2.27% target weight). Maintain current position size, accumulate only on technical pullbacks near Keltner lower support ($17.39), and prepare tactical trims on spikes above $25.00.

bear.rationale: Bitcoin hash difficulty surges while mining economics compress; heavy ongoing ATM equity dilution to fund fleet upgrades.
risks: Prolonged Bitcoin price consolidation below mining breakeven levels
Persistent ATM share dilution exceeding 3% per year

base.rationale: Corsicana and Rockdale facilities reach 1+ GW capacity; BTC prices support profitable mining and power grid demand response revenue.
risks: Texas ERCOT grid power demand response curtailment volatility
ASIC efficiency race requiring continuous capital reinvestment

bull.rationale: Strategic pivot of excess power interconnects to AI HPC colocation alongside record BTC bull run cash flows.
risks: Hyperscaler competition in high-density power interconnect acquisition
Regulatory headwinds on proof-of-work mining power consumption
